preconditions.description: The number of rooms n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= v <= 10**6 for x, y, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two rooms (x, y) within the range [1, n] and has a traversal time v between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.
The number of different values of l to process is between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= 10**11 for l in ls)
preconditions.description: Each value of l is between 1 and 100,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of answers is equal to the number of different values of l.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= answer <= n for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer is the maximum number of children that can be accommodated in the rooms such that the difference between the time the first and last child arrives at the ground is not larger than the corresponding l, and the rooms form a connected set.
